blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
As LLM capabilities advance, agents are tackling increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons. Their growing interaction histories make memory compaction essential for staying within context windows and reducing prefill cost. Existing methods summarize the history or compress its KV cache, often adding model computation to preserve information for future requests. A new user request can change which history matters, but reassessing that history with the model requires re-encoding it if the KV cache has expired.
Past attention provides signals of historical importance and dependencies between messages, while relevance to the current task must be assessed using the new user request. We introduce ReCAP , a memory compaction method that stores attention-derived importance scores and dependency links in a lightweight, persistent context graph. For each new request, ReCAP combines stored importance with relevance cues from the request and follows dependency links to select messages and their supporting context, without additional model calls for selection.
Compared with Codex’s default summarization-based compaction, ReCAP reduces estimated latency for compaction and cold restoration by approximately 95 % 95\% on both Qwen3-Coder and gpt-oss. It also roughly halves the historical context per call on SWE-Together at comparable task quality and improves accuracy on the code tasks of Lost-in-Conversation over full history by 19.8 19.8 and 41.2 41.2 points. Code is available at https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/ReCAP .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Advances in LLM capabilities are enabling agents to solve increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons ( e.g. , repository-level coding and autonomous research). Such workflows can run for tens of minutes to hours, accumulating user instructions, intermediate decisions, and tool outputs as execution proceeds. The resulting history can eventually exceed the model’s finite context window. It also raises inference cost: measurements of agentic workloads report inputs tens of times longer than their generated outputs, making repeated context encoding a substantial part of execution ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Modern agent harnesses and recent research therefore adopt memory compaction , which consolidates session memory into a shorter context ( Kang et al., 2025 ) . By limiting the history carried into subsequent calls, compaction allows the agent to continue beyond a single context window while reducing repeated prefilling.
blocks.zh: 在LLM能力方面的进步使代理人能够在较长的视野内解决日益复杂的任务(例如储存层编码和自主研究)。 这种工作流程可以运行数十分钟到小时,积累用户指令,中间决定,以及工具输出作为执行过程. 由此形成的历史最终会超过模型的有限上下文窗口. 这也提高了推论成本:计量代理工作量报告的投入比其产出长数十倍,使重复的背景编码成为执行的很大一部分(Lu等人,2026年)。 因此,现代代理人利用和最近的研究采用了内存紧凑(Kang等人,2025年)。 通过将所携带的历史限制在后续的呼叫中,收缩使代理能够持续到单个上下文窗口之外,同时减少重复的预填.

blocks.en:
Existing approaches compact agent memory either by summarizing the history into a shorter prompt or by retaining a subset or compressed form of the model’s KV cache ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zweiger et al., 2026 ) . Doing so efficiently across an interactive session involves three linked challenges.
❶ What to retain depends on future use. A new user request can change the task’s direction or revisit an earlier decision, so compaction performed before it arrives must preserve information for needs not yet known. Query-aware KV eviction, for instance, degrades when later queries differ from the one that guided eviction ( Li et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) .
❷ Anticipating future use requires additional computation. Deciding which history a later request will use requires queries that resemble that request, which do not yet exist when compaction runs. Attention Matching ( Zweiger et al., 2026 ) , for example, synthesizes such reference queries by re-prefilling the context or simulating interactions and fits the compact cache to them, adding model computation to every compaction.
❸ Cache expiration adds reconstruction cost. In about 4,300 4{,}300 Claude Code and Codex sessions, user think time accounts for 92 % 92\% of session time, and requests after hour-long gaps almost always miss the serving cache ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Compacted KV states must then be stored and reloaded ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , and a compactor that waits for the request must re-encode the history to obtain fresh attention.

现有接近紧凑剂内存的方法有的是将历史总结为较短的瞬间,有的则是保留模型KV缓存的子集或压缩形式(Kang等人,2025年;Li等人,2024年;Zweiger等人,2026年)。 通过互动会议高效率地开展这项工作涉及三个相互关联的挑战。
❶ 保留什么取决于未来用途。 新的用户请求可以改变任务的方向或重新审视早先的决定,因此,在到达之前所做的压缩必须保存信息,以满足尚未知道的需求。 例如,当后来的询问与指导驱逐的询问不同时,KV的驱逐就会退化(Li等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Each forward pass of the agent already computes attention over its history, yet this signal is discarded once the request completes. We study how coding agents attend to their histories across user turns and find that attention concentrates on a small part of the history, that past attention predicts which history the next turn reuses, and that the arriving request redirects attention (§ 3.2 ). In light of these findings, we propose ReCAP , a memory compaction method that keeps this attention rather than discarding it and organizes it in a lightweight, persistent context graph (Figure 1 ): nodes are history blocks annotated with accumulated importance, and edges link each block to the earlier blocks it depends on. When a new request arrives, ReCAP selects from the full history by combining stored importance with the request’s identifier overlap and following dependency edges, so selection adapts to the actual request and can restore previously omitted blocks (❶). The graph is built from attention that inference computes anyway, and selection uses only graph traversal and string matching, so compaction adds no model call (❷). Because the graph persists independently of the KV cache, ReCAP can select after the cache expires without re-encoding the full history (❸).

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We show that attention from ordinary agent inference concentrates on a small part of the history, predicts which history the next turn reuses, and is redirected by the arriving request (§ 3.2 ). • We propose ReCAP , which persists this attention in a context graph of block importance and dependencies and queries it for each new request to select context without an additional model call, independently of the KV cache (§ 4 ). • On SWE-Together ( Wu et al., 2026b ) and the code tasks of Lost-in-Conversation ( Laban et al., 2026 ) with two model families, ReCAP reduces the estimated latency of compaction and cold restoration by approximately 95 % 95\% relative to Codex’s default summarization, roughly halves the historical context on SWE-Together at comparable quality, and improves Lost-in-Conversation accuracy over full-history conditioning by 19.8 19.8 and 41.2 41.2 points (§ 5 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Context management for LLM agents. Agent harnesses summarize long histories with the backbone, and recent work optimizes such compressors or trains agents to fold their own context ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) ; both add model computation and discard detail irreversibly. Cheaper alternatives mask old observations ( Lindenbauer et al., 2025 ) or prune text with small models ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) . Two recent methods select history by dependencies or attention at higher cost. ContextWeaver calls the backbone at every step to identify the earlier steps it depends on and to summarize these dependencies, and it replaces the observations of all other steps with placeholders ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . AttnCompress reruns a separate 4B-parameter model over the trajectory and scores blocks by the attention of the agent’s next generation step, recomputing all scores at each refresh ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Both target autonomous single-issue runs, in which no new user request redirects the task. ReCAP records importance and dependencies from the agent’s own attention during inference and accumulates them across turns. When a user request arrives, it selects from the full archive without a model call, so omitted blocks can return.
blocks.zh: LLM代理商的背景管理. Agent tapes用骨干总结了漫长的历史,最近的工作优化了这样的压缩机或火车代理,以折叠自己的上下文(Kang等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2026年);两者都增加了模型计算和不可逆转的丢弃细节. 便宜的替代品掩盖了旧的观测结果(Lindenbauer等人,2025年)或小模型的prune文本(Pan等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2024年)。 最近两种方法通过依赖或关注选择历史,成本较高. 背景Weaver在每一个步骤上都称骨干,以识别它所依赖的早期步骤,并总结这些依赖性,它用占位符取代了所有其他步骤的观察(Wu等人,2026a). AtnCompress通过代理商下一代步骤的注意,在轨迹和分数块上重新运行一个单独的4B参数模型,在每次刷新时重算所有分数(Zeng等人,2026年). 两个目标自主的单问题运行,其中没有新的用户请求重定向任务. ReCAP记录了在推论期间从代理商自身注意力中获取的重要性和依赖性,并积累了这些重要性和依赖性。 当用户请求到达时,它会在没有模型调用的情况下从完整的归档中选择,因此省略的块可以返回.

blocks.en: KV-cache compression and reuse. KV methods evict cached entries by attention statistics ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) or fit compact states ( Zweiger et al., 2026 ) , and query-aware eviction degrades when later queries differ ( Li et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . In agents, compacting each turn immediately loses accuracy, while waiting for later queries requires keeping the uncompressed cache meanwhile ( Liu et al., 2026 ) ; learned cross-turn scoring still evicts entries permanently ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Recallable methods and serving systems avoid such loss by keeping full caches or session state in GPU or host memory ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . Yet user think time dominates coding-agent sessions, and caches often expire across these gaps ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . ReCAP waits for the actual request without holding KV state: its text archive and graph survive cache expiration, and it coexists with prefix caching.
blocks.zh: KV-cache压缩和再利用. KV方法通过注意力统计驱逐缓存条目(Zhang等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年;Feng等人,2026年)或适配紧凑状态(Zweiger等人,2026年),当后来的询问不同时,了解查询的驱逐会退化(Li等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年)。 在代理商中,对每个转弯的压缩会立即失去准确性,而等待以后的查询则需要同时保留未压缩的缓存(Liu等人,2026年);所学的交叉计分仍然会永久驱逐条目(Li等人,2026年). 可召回的方法和服务系统通过在GPU或主机内存中保留全部缓存或会话状态来避免这种损失(Tang等人,2024年;Xiao等人,2024年;Gao等人,2024年;Gao等人,2025年). 然而用户认为时间主导了编码代理会话,缓存经常在这些空白之间过期(Zhu等人,2026年). ReCAP在不持有KV状态的情况下等待实际请求:其文本存档和图表在缓存过期后幸存,并与前缀缓存共存.

blocks.en: 3.1 Query-conditioned memory compaction
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 查询条件化的内存压缩

blocks.en: An agent session alternates between user requests and agent execution. In turn t t , the user sends a request q t q_{t} , and the agent produces assistant messages, tool calls, and tool results before returning control; H t H_{t} denotes the accumulated history. When q t + 1 q_{t+1} arrives, memory compaction constructs a smaller working context from H t H_{t} for the new request, limiting the history carried into subsequent calls and thus both context-window pressure and encoding cost. If the previous KV state has expired or been evicted, the engine rebuilds it by prefilling this compact context.

blocks.en:
We seek a compactor that (i) selects context from stored information without an additional model call when a request arrives, (ii) keeps tool calls paired with their results, (iii) keeps the selected historical prefix fixed across tool steps within a user turn for prefix-cache reuse, and (iv) adapts to the arriving request, including requests that revisit earlier work.
These requirements separate two sources of evidence: historical usage becomes available during execution, whereas relevance to the next request can be assessed only after that request arrives. A reusable representation of past usage can connect these two stages, even when the KV state is no longer available.

我们寻求一个压缩器,以(一)从存储的信息中选择上下文,在请求到达时无需附加模型调用,(二)将工具调用与其结果对齐,(三)将选定的历史前缀固定在用户转弯内,用于前缀切换再利用,(四)适应到达请求,包括重新审视先前工作的请求.
这些要求将两个证据来源分开:在执行期间可以使用历史,而与下一个请求的相关性只有在该请求到达之后才能评估。 旧用法的可重复使用表述可以连接这两个阶段,即使KV状态不再可用.

blocks.en: Observation 1: attention concentrates on a small part of the history. In one coding session (Figure 2 , left), attention is unevenly distributed over historical blocks at every checkpoint: ranking blocks by attention per token within a 10 % 10\% historical-token budget retains 65 % 65\% of the attention mass at the final checkpoint. The reuse-study transitions show the same concentration (Appendix B ). This concentration gives a compactor a ranking signal for allocating a limited context budget.
blocks.zh: 观察1:注意力集中在历史的一小部分. 在一次编码会话(图2,左)中,每个检查站的注意力在历史街区上分布不均:在10%的10%的历史上记录预算范围内,每个标志的注意力按顺序排列,在最后检查站保留65%的注意力。 复用研究过渡显示相同的浓度(附录B ). 这种集中给一个压缩器分配有限上下文预算的排序信号.

blocks.en: Observation 2: past attention predicts subsequent reuse. We evaluate selection signals over 64 64 turn transitions from eight coding-agent sessions, approximating reuse by the IDF-weighted coverage of identifiers that appear during the next turn’s execution. At a 10 % 10\% historical-text budget, ranking by attention from the preceding turn reaches a median coverage of about 0.68 0.68 , close to the 0.71 0.71 of a future-use oracle that ranks blocks by those identifiers (Figure 2 , middle). Past attention thus supplies an importance signal that remains useful beyond the turn in which it was measured. Adding overlap with the incoming query’s identifiers yields about 0.69 0.69 . We next hold the history fixed to isolate the request’s effect on attention.
blocks.zh: 观测结果2:以往的注意预测以后的再利用. 我们评价超过64个选择信号, 在10%的历史文字预算中,通过对上一个回合的注意排名,达到约0.68 0.68的中位覆盖率,接近未来使用甲骨文的0.71 0.71,用这些标识符排列区块(图2,中间)。 因此,以往的注意提供了一个重要的信号,在计量的周期之外仍然有用。 与输入的查询标识符重叠后,可产生约0.69 0.69。 我们接下来将固定历史,以孤立请求对注意力的影响。

blocks.en: Observation 3: the arriving request redirects attention. For each of 32 32 tasks, we hold one historical context fixed and vary only the request, using two phrasings for each of two target files, and measure attention change over historical blocks by total-variation distance. Changing the target redistributes 10.1 % 10.1\% of attention on average, compared with 5.3 % 5.3\% for paraphrasing (Figure 2 , right), and produces greater redistribution in 28 28 of the 32 32 tasks. This pattern also holds for requests that explicitly ask the agent to recall earlier work (Appendix B.2 ). Historical importance therefore supports selection across turns, while the arriving request adds a cue for relevance to the current task.
blocks.zh: 意见3:抵达的请求重新引起注意。 对于32个32个任务,我们每个固定一个历史上下文,只更改请求,对两个目标文件的每个文件使用两个措辞,用总变异距离来衡量历史块的注意力变化. 改变目标平均重新分配了10.1%的注意力,相比之下,在32项任务中,5.3%的注意力用于解释(图2,正确的),并在28项任务中实现更大的重新分配。 这种模式还适用于明确要求代理人回顾先前工作的请求(附录B.2)。 因此,历史重要性支持跨轮选择,而抵达的请求增加了与当前任务相关的提示。

blocks.en: These observations motivate preserving historical importance between turns and combining it with the current request when selecting context. ReCAP does so with a persistent context graph: message nodes retain attention-derived importance, and attention links provide dependency cues for supporting context, independently of the KV cache.
blocks.zh: 这些观察促使人们在选择上下文时,在转弯和结合当前要求之间保持历史重要性。 ReCAP使用一个持久的上下文图来做到这一点:消息节点保留了引起注意的重要性,注意力链接提供了支持上下文的依赖提示,独立于KV缓存.

blocks.en: 4 ReCAP : Memory Compaction with a Persistent Context Graph
blocks.zh: 4 ReCAP : 内存缩合与持续背景图

blocks.en: ReCAP maintains a persistent context graph that connects past attention to future compaction decisions: node scores summarize historical importance, and directed edges record attention-based dependencies between messages. It updates the graph using attention from agent execution and queries it when a new user request arrives, combining stored importance with relevance to that request and including supporting context through graph traversal. Figure 3 illustrates the workflow; Algorithm 1 in Appendix D.2 gives the complete procedure.
blocks.zh: ReCAP保持一个持续的上下文图,将过去的注意力与未来的紧凑决定联系起来:节点得分总结了历史的重要性,定向边缘记录了消息之间基于注意力的依赖关系. 它利用代理执行的注意力对图表进行更新,并在新用户请求到达时进行查询,将存储的重要性与该请求的相关性结合起来,包括通过图转录支持上下文. 图3显示了工作流程;附录D.2中的算法1给出了完整的程序.

blocks.en: Figure 3: ReCAP workflow. 1–2: Sampled attention supplies node importance and support-to-dependent edges. 3: Selection combines stored importance with the query’s identifier overlap, keeps protected records, and adds one-hop predecessors (diagnosis m 5 m_{5} brings in search record m 2 m_{2} ), without a model call. 4–5: Execution produces new messages and attention that update the graph.

The selection stays fixed as tool steps extend the turn, allowing prefix-cache reuse, and execution feeds attention to the next update, completing the cycle.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmarks and models. We evaluate ReCAP on two interactive coding benchmarks: 106 106 tasks from SWE-Together ( Wu et al., 2026b ) , which involves repository-level tasks with tool use and user feedback, and 100 100 code instances from Lost-in-Conversation (LiC) ( Laban et al., 2026 ) , which reveal requirements across user turns, with five conversations per instance. Our backbones are Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and gpt-oss-20b ( OpenAI et al., 2025 ) , served with SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . SWE-Together runs in OpenCode, and GPT-5.4 simulates all users.
blocks.zh: 基准和模式。 我们根据两个交互式编码基准对ReCAP进行评估:106 106项来自SWE-Together的任务(Wu等人,2026b),涉及存储器一级的任务,包括工具使用和用户反馈;100项来自LiC-in-Conversation(LiC)(Laban等人,2026年)的代码实例,揭示了各个用户回合的要求,每个实例有5个对话。 我们的骨干是Qune3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct(杨等人,2025年)和gpt-oss-20b(OpenAI等人,2025年),服务于SGLang(郑等人,2024年). SWE-together在OpenCode运行,GPT-5.4模拟所有用户.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against full-history restoration and six compaction baselines in three groups. Heuristic baselines select history without model computation: Recency retains the most recent content, and Random samples content and restores its order. Prompt-compression baselines, LLMLingua-2 ( Pan et al., 2024 ) and LongLLMLingua ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , compress historical text with a small model, the latter conditioned on the request. Memory-compaction baselines use the backbone itself: Codex-style summarization ( OpenAI, 2025 ) generates a handoff summary while preserving historical user instructions, and KV eviction ( Liu et al., 2026 ) keeps, per attention head, the cached entries most attended by the new user message and discards the rest permanently. All compactors operate on history preceding the current user turn, with system instructions and current-turn messages retained separately; KV eviction also ranks cached system instructions.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了全部历史恢复和六组压缩基线。 高压基线选择历史而不进行模型计算: 审慎保留最新内容,随机样本内容并恢复其顺序. 快速压缩基线,LLMLingua-2(Pan等人,2024年)和LongLLLMLingua (Jiang et al., 2024),用一个小模型压缩历史文字,后者以请求为条件. 内存比较基线使用主干线本身: Codex-style summarization(OpenAI,2025)在保留历史用户指令的同时生成一个交接摘要,KV拆迁(Liu等人,2026年)每个注意头保留了被新用户消息最多注意的缓存条目,并将其余部分永久丢弃. 所有压缩机在当前用户转弯前都按历史运行,系统指令和当前转弯消息单独保留;KV拆解也按缓存系统指令排序.

blocks.en: End-to-end protocol and budgets. Compaction affects subsequent responses, tool use, and user interactions, so methods develop different histories, and matching tokens at every turn would require adjusting budgets as trajectories evolve. We therefore fix each method’s hyperparameters throughout execution: a nominal retention of β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 for history selection, a compression rate of 0.1 0.1 for Lingua ( 0.2 0.2 for LiC LLMLingua-2), and 10 % 10\% of the historical cache entries per head for KV eviction. ReCAP counts protected records toward its budget and retains them when they exceed it, and summarization sets its own summary length. We compare task quality together with realized context usage and compaction overhead (Appendix C ).

blocks.en: We ablate ReCAP on the LiC code tasks with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B under the protocol of Table 1 . Removing the attention graph discards importance scores, dependency expansion, and stale marks, leaving a selector that keeps the protected records and fills the remaining budget by identifier overlap with the request. The segmentation variants split plain assistant messages into paragraphs or lines instead of one block, keeping fenced code intact. All three variants score below ReCAP (Table 2 ): by 8.8 8.8 points without the attention graph, and by 2.2 2.2 and 2.4 2.4 points with paragraph and line blocks. They also differ in context size: without the attention graph, the working context stays at 95 95 tokens on average ( 94 94 for ReCAP ), whereas finer blocks let fragments of earlier answers fit within the budget, raising it to 152 152 and 168 168 tokens.

blocks.zh: 5.5 与前缀缓存兼容性

blocks.en: Figure 5: ReCAP with prefix caching (gpt-oss-20b, SWE-Together). (a) Idle boundaries prefill the compact context S n S_{n} ; warm ones reuse the cache; the graph updates in the background. blocks.en: Memory compaction targets requests that arrive after the serving cache has expired. Many user turns, however, arrive while the session’s KV cache is still resident, and prefix caching already avoids re-encoding the history for them. ReCAP complements prefix caching rather than replacing it: it rewrites the working context only when the cache is gone (Figure 5 a). At an idle boundary, ReCAP selects a compact context S n S_{n} , which the engine prefills. At a warm boundary, it skips selection: the next request is appended to the resident context, so the model sees S n S_{n} , the complete turn n n , and the new request, and the engine reuses their cached prefix. Within a turn, the selected history likewise stays fixed. Graph updates stay off the critical path: attention statistics are captured during inference, and the graph is updated on the CPU in the background, overlapping the next turn’s generation at warm boundaries and the idle period at idle boundaries.
blocks.zh: 内存压缩目标请求在服务缓存过期后到达. 然而,许多用户在会话的 KV 缓存仍为常住时转身到达,而且前缀缓存已经避免了为他们重新编码历史。 ReCAP补充前缀缓存而不是替换它:它只在缓存消失时才会重写工作上下文(图5 a). 在闲置的边界上, ReCAP 选择一个紧凑的上下文 S n S_{n}, 引擎会预填. 在温暖的边界上,它跳过选择:下一个请求被附加到常住语境中,所以模型看到Sn S_{n},完整的转弯n n,和新的请求,引擎重用它们缓存的前缀. 在转弯之内,选定的历史也同样保持不变。 图表更新远离关键路径:在推论中获取注意力统计,在背景中更新CPU,在温暖的边界上重叠下一代和闲置边界上的闲置期.

blocks.en:
We evaluate this policy on SWE-Together with gpt-oss-20b served by vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) with automatic prefix caching. At each user boundary, a seeded draw marks the session warm with probability p p , keeping its cache, or idle, discarding it and running ReCAP ; we run p ∈ { 25 % , 50 % , 75 % } p\in\{25\%,50\%,75\%\} once each.
Warm boundaries reuse over 99.9 % 99.9\% of their prompt tokens from the cache. As p p rises from 25 % 25\% to 75 % 75\% , the cache-hit rate grows from 72 % 72\% to 87 % 87\% and uncached prompt tokens per request fall by 44 % 44\% (Figure 5 b). The engine returns the first token in a median of 0.10 0.10 s at warm boundaries, compared with 1.58 1.58 s when an idle boundary prefills the compacted context (Figure 5 c). Task reward stays between 8.7 8.7 and 9.7 9.7 across the three settings, with no significant difference from the 25 % 25\% setting (Figure 5 d), and is 9.0 9.0 when every boundary is idle (Table 1 ). Consecutive warm turns carry their appended history, so the average prompt grows from 15.1 15.1 k to 17.8 17.8 k tokens, but the cache serves this growth. Prefix caching thus serves turns whose cache survives, and ReCAP serves turns whose cache has expired, without undoing each other.
blocks.zh:
我们在SWE-Toher上评价这个政策, 在每个用户边界上,一个种子绘图标记了会议段与概率 p , 保持其缓存, 或闲置, 丢弃它和运行 ReCAP ; 我们运行 p { 25%, 50%, 75% } p\in 25\ , 50\ 75\ 一次。
温暖的边界重复使用99.9%以上的来自缓存的迅速信号。 由于pp从25% 25\%上升到75% 75\%,缓存打击率从72% 72\%上升到87% 87\%,每一次请求的未标记的即时信号下降44% 44\%(图5 b). 引擎在温暖边界时以0.10 0.10 s的中位值返回第一个令牌,而闲置边界预填紧凑上下文时为1.58 1.58 s(图5 c). 任务奖励停留在8.7 8.7 和 9.7 9.7 之间的三种设置,与25% 25 +% 的设置(图 5 d)没有显著区别,每个边界闲置时为 9.0 9.0 (表 1)。 连续的温暖转弯承载了它们所附的历史,所以平均的速率从15.1 15.1 k增加到17.8 17.8 k令牌,但缓存服务于这种增长. 前缀缓存因此服务于缓存存活的转动,而ReCAP服务于缓存已过期的转动,而不相互折叠.

blocks.en: ReCAP reads attention from the agent’s own model, which a closed API does not expose. Because the graph stores block-level statistics, it can come from a different model that replays the served context with its own tokenizer and maps its attention back to the same blocks. We use Qwen3-0.6B, about 2 2 – 3 % 3\% of the agent’s parameters, as the proxy for a Qwen3-Coder-30B agent from the same family and a gpt-oss-20b agent from a different family, with all other settings as in Table 1 .

blocks.en: The proxy matches the agent’s own attention in all three settings (Table 3 ): the differences are + 0.6 +0.6 and − 0.2 -0.2 points on LiC with gpt-oss and Qwen, and + 0.5 +0.5 points on SWE-Together with Qwen, none statistically significant. With Qwen on LiC, removing the attention graph lowers accuracy, and the proxy retains this gain, scoring 8.6 8.6 points above the no-attention variant. A small open model can therefore supply attention for a black-box agent, including one from a different model family.

blocks.zh: 附录 A 只在分数选择下失败

blocks.en: Two representative failures when selection uses scores alone, without protected records. (i) Task statement evicted at cold start: at the first post-eviction turn of a session whose instruction was to analyze a GitHub issue (analysis only, no implementation), the selector kept the agent’s own 215-character preamble and dropped the 9,116-character task block. The agent then asserted it had read the issue, invented a different problem (a bug in a nonexistent reset command), spent some twenty steps searching for files that do not exist, and shipped an unrelated edit. (ii) Own-edit record evicted: the selector kept stale analysis prose describing the pre-edit code as current while dropping the tool-call record of the agent’s own just-completed fix. On re-reading the file, the agent found code it did not remember writing, concluded that the issue had “already been fixed” and that no further changes were needed, and repeated that conclusion until the session ended. In both cases the lost information was recoverable from the workspace through ordinary tools—but the agent had no signal that anything needed recovering.
blocks.zh: 选择时仅使用分数,没有受保护的记录时有两个代表性的失败. (一) 冷启动时删除的任务说明:在会议的第一个后转弯时,其指示是分析一个GitHub问题(只进行分析,没有执行),选择者保留了代理商自己的215特征前言,并放弃了9 116特征任务块。 该代理随后断言它读过这个问题,发明了一个不同的问题(一个不存在的重置命令中的bug),花了大约20步搜索不存在的文件,并运出一个无关的编辑. (二) 自行编辑的记录被删除:选择者保留了将预编辑代码描述为时态的 stale analysis,同时放弃了代理者自己刚刚完成的修复的工具调用记录。 在重新阅读文件时,代理人发现了它不记得写作的代码,得出结论,这个问题“已经固定了”,不需要作进一步修改,并重复了这一结论,直到会议结束。 在这两种情况下,丢失的信息都可以通过普通工具从工作空间中收回——但代理商没有迹象表明任何需要收回的信息。

blocks.en: Multi-turn attention example. The left panel of Figure 2 shows one coding session at six measured user-turn checkpoints. Each incoming request supplies attention queries over its preceding history. We aggregate received attention over the tokens of each historical block and normalize its mass over the history. For selection, blocks are ranked by attention mass per token and greedily packed under a 10 % 10\% historical-token budget. At the final checkpoint, the selected blocks contain 2,824 2{,}824 of 28,309 28{,}309 tokens and retain 65.01 % 65.01\% of historical attention. Heatmap columns and the concatenated context use the same token-length scale. Color denotes per-token attention divided by the maximum within each row, displayed on a cube-root scale.
blocks.zh: 多回合关注的例子。 图2的左侧面板显示在6个测量的用户转弯检查站有一个编码段. 收到的每项请求都提供过去历史的注意查询。 我们汇集了对每个历史街区标志物的关注,使其质量在历史中正常化。 区块按每个标志的注意力量排序, 在最后的检查站,选定的区块包含2,824,2{,}28,309个标志中的824个,保留65.01%的65.01\%历史关注. 加热图柱和整齐上下文使用相同的符号长度尺度. 彩色表示每行内以立方根比例显示的最大值除以每根注意力。

blocks.en: Cross-turn study. The middle panel of Figure 2 uses 64 64 transitions from eight coding-agent sessions. Past-attention scores aggregate attention sampled from the preceding completed turn across heads at layers { 16 , 24 , 32 , 40 } \{16,24,32,40\} of the 48 48 -layer model. Candidate blocks precede that completed turn. Block scores summarize received attention per token. Figure 6 also reports aggregate concentration and the full comparison of selection signals.
blocks.zh: 交叉转学. 图2的中间面板使用从8个编码代理会话的64个64个过渡. 从先前完成的模型中抽取的过去注意分数,在48个48级模型中以 {16,24,32,40} 的 {16,24,32,40} 的 – 16,32,40 } 轮到头顶。 候选区块在完成回合之前。 积分汇总每个符号都得到了关注. 图6还报告了总浓度和选择信号的全面比较。

blocks.en: Identifier-coverage proxy. Target identifiers are extracted from assistant and tool-result text, together with tool-call names and arguments, recorded before the following user message. The incoming user request itself is excluded from this evidence. The extractor retains code-like identifiers of at least four characters and dotted paths under a short stop list. An identifier occurring in df \mathrm{df} of the n n candidate blocks receives weight log ⁡ ( n / df ) \log(n/\mathrm{df}) . Only target identifiers appearing in the candidate history contribute to the denominator. Coverage is the fraction of their total weight present in the selected block set. Selectors rank blocks and pack them greedily under a fraction of the historical-text length; the evaluation code counts characters. The future-use oracle ranks blocks by overlap with the future target identifiers and uses the same packing rule. The combined selector adds a query-identifier score to past attention; the standalone query-identifier and embedding comparisons appear in Figure 6 .
blocks.zh: 识别器- 覆盖代理 。 从助手和工具结果文本中提取目标标识符,以及工具调用名称和参数,记录在以下用户信息之前. 收到的用户请求本身被排除在这些证据之外。 提取器在短站列表下保留了至少四个字符和点缀路径的类似代码的标识符. 在 n 候选区块的 df\mathrm{df} 中发生的标识符会收到重量日志 {} (n / df)\log(n/\mathrm{df}) 。 只有候选人历史中出现的目标识别符才有助于分母。 覆盖度是它们在选定区块集中的总重量的一小部分。 选择者对块进行排序,并贪婪地将其打包在历史文本长度的一小部分下;评价码数字符. 未来用途甲骨文通过与未来目标标识符的重叠排列区块,并使用相同的包装规则. 合并选择器为过去的注意增加了一个查询识别分数;独立的查询识别器和嵌入比较在图6中出现.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Additional historical-context observations. Left: Aggregate attention concentration under a retained-history budget; the diagonal denotes uniform attention per unit of history. Middle: The full comparison of selection signals, including query identifiers and query embeddings. Right: User-instruction and latest-edit records omitted by attention-ranked selection, together with the fraction of transitions losing any protected record. The selector receives enough budget to fit the complete protected set.
blocks.zh: 图6:其他历史文字观察。 左方:保留历史预算下的注意力集中;对角表示每个历史单位的统一注意力. 中间 : 完全比较选择信号,包括查询标识符和查询嵌入. 对: 用户指令和最新编辑的记录被注意排序选择省略,加上过渡的一小部分丢失了任何受保护的记录. 选择器获得足够的预算来适应完整的受保护的集.

blocks.en: B.2 Controlled query study
blocks.zh: B.2 控制查询研究

blocks.en: Fixed histories and requests. We select one checkpoint from each of 32 32 distinct coding tasks, with 16 16 histories from ReCAP traces and 16 16 from recency-selection traces. Histories range from 8 8 k to 32 32 k rendered tokens. Each history contains explicit references to two target files, chosen before attention measurement. Historical block contents and identities remain fixed across request conditions.
blocks.zh: 固定的历史和要求。 我们从32个32个不同的编码任务中各选一个检查站,其中16个来自RECAP的痕迹,16个来自复选的痕迹。 历史从8,8k到32,32k 的成品。 每个历史都明确提到两个目标文件,在注意度量之前选定。 历史区块内容和身份在请求条件中保持不变。

blocks.en: For each target, we construct two short requests that ask the agent to continue or return to that file. This yields four requests per history. We repeat the comparison with longer, framed requests that explicitly ask the agent to recall earlier implementation facts, constraints, and tool observations. The two template families therefore provide eight measurements per history, or 256 256 in total. Only the incoming request changes between measurements.
blocks.zh: 对于每个目标,我们构建两个短请求,要求代理继续或返回文件. 这样每个历史都收到4项请求。 我们重复了与较长、框架化的要求的比较,这些要求明确要求代理人回顾早先的执行事实、制约因素和工具观察。 因此,两个模板家庭提供每条历史的8个测量数据,总共256 256个。 只有收到的请求在测量值之间有所变化。

blocks.en: Attention redistribution. We normalize attention mass over historical blocks after excluding the initial task instruction. For two resulting distributions p p and q q , redistribution is their total-variation distance, D TV ​ ( p , q ) = 1 2 ​ ∑ v | p ⁡ ( v ) − q ⁡ ( v ) | . D_{\mathrm{TV}}(p,q)=\frac{1}{2}\sum_{v}|p(v)-q(v)|. (4) Within each template family, a history contributes one paraphrase value, averaging the two same-target comparisons, and one goal-change value, averaging the four cross-target comparisons. Statistical analysis treats histories as paired observations.
blocks.zh: 注意再分配 在排除了最初的任务指示之后,我们使注意力在历史街区上正常化。 对于两个产生的分布p和q q,再分配是它们的总变异距离,D TV (p, q) = 1 2 ∑ v | p ⁡ (v) → q ⁡ (v) |. D_{\mathrm{TV}} (p, q) =\frac{ 1}{2}\sum_{v}|p(v)-q(v)| |. (4) 在每个模板家族中,一个历史提供了一个解释值,平均两个同目标比较和一个目标变化值,平均四个跨目标比较。 统计分析将历史视为配对观测。

blocks.en: Results and visualization. For short requests, mean redistribution is 5.33 % 5.33\% under paraphrasing and 10.13 % 10.13\% under a target change. The paired difference is 4.81 4.81 percentage points (task-bootstrap 95 % 95\% CI [ 3.41 , 6.25 ] [3.41,6.25] ) and is positive in 28 / 32 28/32 histories. Framed requests give 3.82 % 3.82\% and 8.46 % 8.46\% , respectively, with a paired difference of 4.64 4.64 points ( [ 3.64 , 5.69 ] [3.64,5.69] ), positive in 30 / 32 30/32 histories. Confidence intervals use 10,000 10{,}000 task-bootstrap resamples.

Figure 7: Query effects across request templates. Paraphrases of the same target and requests about different targets are compared on the same 32 32 histories. Longer framed requests explicitly ask the agent to recall earlier facts and constraints. Both template families show greater attention redistribution under a target change. Curves share a smoothing bandwidth; bottom ticks identify the paired task-level observations, and the dashed line marks zero redistribution.
blocks.zh: 图7:请求模板的查询效果。 同一目标的措辞和关于不同目标的请求在32个历史中进行比较。 较长范围的请求明确要求代理人回顾以前的事实和制约因素。 两个模板家庭在目标变化下表现出更多的关注再分配。 曲线共享一个平滑带宽;底盘勾选识别对齐的任务级观测,虚线标记为零再分配.

blocks.en: B.3 Preserving instructions and recent modifications
blocks.zh: B.3 保留指示和最近的修改

blocks.en: User instructions specify the task, and the latest edit or write record for each modified file records the agent’s most recent changes. We protect these blocks as the session’s skeleton. In the cross-turn corpus, this set occupies a median 10.3 % 10.3\% of historical text. To measure whether attention ranking retains it, we give the selector budget max ⁡ ( β ​ c ​ ( V t ) , c ⁡ ( P t ) ) \max(\beta\,c(V_{t}),c(P_{t})) , so the complete skeleton fits. At β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , score-only selection still omits approximately 37 % 37\% of user messages and 28 % 28\% of latest-edit records, and every transition loses at least one protected block (Figure 6 , right). These measurements motivate explicit protection during packing. Appendix A gives two corresponding failure examples.
blocks.zh: 用户指令指定任务,每个修改文件的最新编辑或写入记录记录代理商最近的更改. 我们保护这些障碍, 在反转体中,这一组占历史文本的中位数10.3%. 为了衡量注意力排位是否保留,我们给选手预算最大QQ(β c(V t),c QQ(P t))\max(\β\,c(V_{t}),c(P_{t})),所以完整的骨架符合. 在β = 0.1\beta=0.1时,只有分数的选择仍然省略了大约37%的用户信件和28%的更新编辑记录,每次过渡至少损失一个受保护块(图6,右). 这些测量方法促使在包装过程中进行明确的保护。 附 录 A给出两个相应的失败例子.

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation protocol and cost accounting
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价协议和成本核算

blocks.en: Tasks and budgets. Table 1 reports SWE-Together results on 106 106 tasks and Lost-in-Conversation results on 100 100 instances, with five conversations scheduled per instance. For LiC, the k k th conversation of every task forms repeat k k . We report the mean and sample standard deviation ( n − 1 n-1 denominator) of the five repeat accuracies. Each repeat has 100 100 tasks, with missing or unscored conversations counted as unsuccessful. SWE-Together standard deviations summarize two replicates.
blocks.zh: 任务和预算。 表1报告SWE-Toge对106 106项任务的结果和100个案例的失联结果,每个案例安排5次对话。 对于LiC,每个任务表的 kk th 对话重复 k k . 我们报告五个重复加速的平均值和样本标准差(n−1n-1分母)。 每一次重复有100项任务,缺失或无分数的对话被算作不成功. SWE - Together标准偏差总结了两种复制.

blocks.en: For history selection, the budget is computed from each method’s own accumulated history. Lingua receives its compression rate through the compressor’s own interface. LiC Recency and Random use line-level splitting of assistant text, while ReCAP uses message-level blocks. ReCAP ’s protected blocks consume the nominal allowance before other blocks are added, and dependency expansion allows up to 10 % 10\% additional budget, subject to the bound in Eq. 6 . These rules and the independently generated histories determine realized usage. The Full row summarizes the full-restoration policy’s own trajectories; per-request compression ratios use each compactor’s own history before and after compression.
blocks.zh: 就历史选择而言,预算是根据每种方法本身的累积历史计算的。 Lingua通过压缩机自己的接口获得压缩率. LiC Recession and Random us line-level 拆分助手文本,而ReCAP则使用消息级别块. ReCAP的保护区块在增加其他区块之前会消耗名义上的补贴,而依赖扩张可允许高达10%的10+Q的追加预算,但需遵守第6项的限额。 这些规则和独立产生的历史决定了实际的使用。 Full一行总结了全面恢复政策本身的轨迹;按要求的压缩比率在压缩前后使用每个压缩器自己的历史.

blocks.en: Token and latency accounting. For SWE-Together, Ctx. reports the mean retained historical content per request. Every method excludes the original system instructions, tool definitions, and current turn from this quantity. For LiC, Ctx. subtracts the fixed rendered system prefix from each complete input: 73 73 tokens for Qwen3-Coder and 135 135 for gpt-oss, the same for all methods. The remaining count includes retained history, the current user turn, message framing, and any omission notice. LiC means cover all completed assistant calls, including the first.
blocks.zh: 盘算和长期会计。 对于SWE-Together,Ctx.报告每个请求的平均保留历史内容. 每一种方法都排除了原始的系统指令,工具定义,以及从这个数量中流转. 对于LiC,Ctx从每个完整的输入中减去固定的渲染系统前缀:Qwen3-Coder的73个令牌,gpt-os的135个令牌,所有方法都一样. 其余的计数包括保留历史、目前的用户回合、信件框架和任何遗漏通知。 LIC表示覆盖所有已完成的助理电话,包括第一个.

blocks.en: Compressor prompt and completion counts use serving-engine usage; a reused summary incurs no new compression call. LLMLingua uses a separate small model, whose computation appears in compression latency. Compression latencies of the baselines are measured on one H100, one request at a time (Appendix C.1 ). For LiC, latency is the mean over 30 30 sampled compression invocations after 10 10 warm-up invocations, timed until the full compressed output is returned. ReCAP ’s selection runs on the CPU without a model call; its +Lat. is the mean selection time on one CPU core (Appendix C.4 ).
blocks.zh: 压缩机即时和完成计数使用可用引擎;再利用的汇总不会出现新的压缩呼叫。 LLMLingua使用单独的小模型,其计算出现在压缩延迟中. 基线的压缩延迟按一个H100计量,一次一次请求(附录C.1 )。 对LIC来说,耐久是10个10个热量引用后平均超过30个样本的压缩引用,计时到完整压缩输出返回为止. ReCAP的选择在CPU上运行,没有模型调用;其+Lat.是在一个CPU核心上的平均选择时间(Appendix C.4 ).

blocks.en: KV eviction. At the start of each user turn after the first, it scores every resident historical entry by its attention from the new user message and keeps ⌈ 0.1 ​ N ⌉ \lceil 0.1N\rceil entries per head, where N N counts all historical tokens, including those evicted earlier. The current input is kept in full, and evicted entries are never recomputed. After eviction, the engine recomputes the final input token against the compacted cache; we omit this single token from +Pre. Its +Lat. is the mean over 30 30 compaction events sampled from the quality runs and replayed on one H100 with caches of the recorded sizes, one event at a time after 10 10 warm-up events. Each measurement covers scoring, selection, the copy into compacted tensors, and the one-token recomputation. Scoring, selection, and copying take 5 5 – 32 32 ms on average, and the one-token recomputation takes the rest. For Ctx. , we count the historical entries retained per head, adding the current input on LiC. These entries may include cached system instructions, so the value is an upper bound on retained history under the other methods’ accounting.
blocks.zh: KV拆迁. 每个用户在第一个后转弯时,会通过新用户消息的注意力给每个常住历史条目打分,并保持QQ 0.1 N \ lceil 0.1N\rceil 条目每头,其中 N N 计所有历史标志,包括之前被逐出的标志. 当前输入被完整保存,被拆卸的条目从未被重算. 拆卸后,引擎将最后的输入符与压缩的缓存重算;我们从+Pre省略了这个单一的令牌. Its +Lat.是从质量运行中抽取的30多个压缩事件,并在一个H100上重新播放了记录大小的缓存,在10个热身事件之后,一次一个事件. 每个测量方法都覆盖计分,选择,复制成紧凑的变压器,以及单键重算. 分数,选数,抄数平均为5 5 – 32 32 ms,单键重算则取其余. 对于Ctx.,我们计算每头保留的历史条目,加上当前在LIC上的输入. 这些条目可能包括缓存的系统指令,因此该值在其他方法的核算下是留存历史的上限.

blocks.en: Memory accounting. +Mem. counts memory that a method keeps for compaction, beyond the backbone weights and the KV cache of the working context. For the Lingua baselines, it is the compressor weights: 2.24 2.24 GB for LLMLingua-2 ( 559 559 M parameters in FP32) and 5.56 5.56 GB for LongLLMLingua (Phi-2, 2.78 2.78 B parameters in FP16), excluding activations. For KV eviction, it is the mean KV cache a session holds when the next user message arrives, before eviction. For ReCAP , it is the context graph at the end of each session, averaged over sessions, stored with 12 12 bytes per node (identifier, score, and flags) and 12 12 bytes per edge (two identifiers and a weight). The full history itself is kept by the agent harness for every method and is not counted. We count at most 6.5 6.5 edges per block, the rate measured on gpt-oss SWE-Together sessions. Because an edge requires more than θ = 0.02 \theta{=}0.02 of the dependent block’s attention mass, each block has at most 49 49 incoming edges; even this worst case stays below 0.8 0.8 MB per session. Full restoration, Recency, Random, and summarization keep no additional state.
blocks.zh: 记忆核算. +Mem.计算一种方法为收缩而保存的内存,超出主干重和工作环境的KV缓存. 对于LLMLingua基线,是压缩机权重:LLMLingua-2的2.24 2.24 GB(FP32中的559 559 M参数)和LongLLMLingua的5.56 5.56 GB(Phi-2,2.78 2.78) FP16中的B参数,不包括激活. 对于KV拆迁,这是当下一个用户信息到达时,在拆迁前,一个会话所持的平均值KV缓存. 对 ReCAP 来说,它是每场会话结束时的上下文图,在会话中平均,每个节点存储有12个12字节(识别符,分数,和旗帜)和12个12字节(两个识别符和一个重量). 全部历史本身由代理机控制,用于每一种方法,不计算在内。 我们计算到每个区块最多6.5个边缘, 速率在gpt-oss SWE-Together sessions上测量. 由于一个边缘需要超过 = 0.02\theta\\0.02 依赖区块的注意力质量,每个区块最多有49个进入区块的边缘;即使这一最坏的情况仍然低于每场0.8 MB。 完全恢复, 复健, 随机, 和归纳 保持不增加状态 。

blocks.en: C.1 Cold-TTFT measurement protocol
blocks.zh: C.1 冷-TTFT测量协议

blocks.en: We measure TTFT on one NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 GPU with SGLang 0.5.17, PyTorch 2.11.0 with CUDA 13.0, Transformers 5.12.1, and FA3 attention. Qwen3-Coder uses native BF16 weights and gpt-oss uses native MXFP4 weights. Each condition contains 30 30 timed synthetic requests after warm-up. No request reuses cached tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们用一台装有SGLang 0.5.17的NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 GPU、装有CUDA 13.0的PyTorch 2.11.0、变形器 5.12.1和FA3的注意力测量TTFT。 Qune3-Coder使用原生BF16重量,gpt-os使用原生MXFP4重量. 每个条件都包含30个加时的加热后合成请求. 没有请求重复使用缓存的符号 。

blocks.en: Synthetic input lengths match the SWE-Together mean historical-context sizes in Table 1 . In the order Full, LLMLingua-2, LongLLMLingua, Summarize (Codex), and ReCAP , these lengths are 28,504 28{,}504 , 11,062 11{,}062 , 7,429 7{,}429 , 5,239 5{,}239 , and 15,344 15{,}344 tokens for Qwen3-Coder, and 8,508 8{,}508 , 3,340 3{,}340 , 2,416 2{,}416 , 4,543 4{,}543 , and 4,043 4{,}043 tokens for gpt-oss. These requests measure cold TTFT at historical-context lengths, excluding the separately supplied system prompt, tool definitions, and current turn.
blocks.zh: 合成输入长度与表1中SWE-Tocher的平均历史文本大小相匹配. 按Full,LLMLingua-2,LongLLMLingua,Summarize(Codex)和ReCAP顺序,这些长度分别为28,504 28{,}504,11,062 11{,}062,7,429 7{,}429,5,239 5{,}239,和15,344 15{,}344 Qune3-Coder的代币,以及8,508 8{,}508,3340 3{,}340,2 416 2{,}416,454 4 4{,}543,和4,043 4{,}043 兆币的代币。 这些请求按历史文本长度测量寒冷的TTFT,不包括单独提供的系统提示、工具定义和当前转弯。

blocks.en: SWE-Together compaction costs are measured on the same GPU, one request at a time: the Lingua compressor shares the GPU with the serving engine, and summarization is a complete additional model call, including prefill and generation, on an idle engine with its cache cleared.
blocks.zh: SWE-Together压缩成本在同一GPU上进行测量,一次一个请求:Lingua压缩机与服务引擎共享GPU,汇总是一个完整的附加模型调用,包括预充和生成,在闲置引擎上,其缓存被清除.

blocks.en: For each condition, Figure 4 adds the mean measured TTFT to the compaction latency in the main table, estimating a request that performs compaction before cold restoration. The reductions shown by the arrows are 100 ​ ( 1 − L ReCAP / L baseline ) 100(1-L_{\textsc{ReCAP}{}}/L_{\mathrm{baseline}}) , where L L is this combined estimate.
blocks.zh: 对于每个条件,图4在主表中的收缩延缓度中增加了平均测量的TTFT,估计了在冷还原前进行收缩的请求. 箭头显示的减少量为100(1 - L ReCAP / L 基线) 100(1-L_{\Textsc{ReCAP}{}}/L_{\mathrm{ 基线}}),其中L L是这一综合估计值.

blocks.en: C.2 Compaction pattern analysis
blocks.zh: C.2 压缩图案分析

blocks.en: Figure 8: History retained by ReCAP on SWE-Together with Qwen3-Coder. (a) Retained blocks in each tenth of the session, relative to a uniform spread; counts include protected records. (b) Origin of the blocks retained at each user turn: kept from the previous working context, revived after being omitted from it, or created since.
blocks.zh: 图8:ReCAP在SWE-Toher上与Qune3-Coder联手保留的历史. (a) 在每届第十届会议上保留区块,相对于统一分布;计数包括受保护的记录。 (b) 每一用户转弯时所保留的区块的起源:与以往的工作环境保持距离,从中省略后恢复,或自此创建。

blocks.en: We examine which history ReCAP carries into the working context, using the compaction records of the Qwen3-Coder SWE-Together runs in Table 1 . Figure 8 a divides each session into ten equal spans by block position and compares each span’s share of retained blocks with a uniform spread. Recency concentrates on the latest span, at 5.3 × 5.3\times its uniform share, and retains almost nothing from the oldest 40 % 40\% of the session, while Random stays close to uniform. ReCAP draws from both ends: the oldest and newest spans each receive about 1.5 × 1.5\times their uniform share, and the middle falls to 0.6 × 0.6\times . The oldest 30 % 30\% of the session supplies 39 % 39\% of the blocks ReCAP retains, compared with 31 % 31\% for random selection and none for recency.

blocks.en: Because ReCAP selects from the full archive at each request, blocks omitted from one working context can return in a later one (Figure 8 b). About 60 % 60\% of retained blocks carry over from the previous working context, and the share of revived blocks grows from 7 % 7\% in turns 3–4 to 18 % 18\% from turn 9 onward; 70 % 70\% of turn transitions revive at least one omitted block. Recency never revives a block once its window has passed it, and KV compaction discards evicted entries permanently, so a later request cannot recover them without re-encoding the full history ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zweiger et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: The example below comes from a SWE-Together session with Qwen3-Coder. At the first user turn, the agent checked the authentication-event routes and handlers with grep . The resulting block is not protected and had no recorded importance, so it stayed outside the working context for the next seven user turns. At turn 8, the user asks the agent to verify these handlers and names six of the functions that appear in the block. These rare identifiers give the block the highest query-overlap score among the 98 98 history blocks, and ReCAP selects it back into the working context under the same 10 % 10\% budget. Because selection runs over the full history at each request, content omitted for several turns can return once a request refers to it.

blocks.zh: C.4 选择费用

blocks.en: We time ReCAP ’s context selection, from block segmentation through scoring, packing, and dependency expansion, on one CPU core (AMD EPYC 7453) for requests of the sizes in Table 1 . Table 4 reports the per-request time. Selection takes about a millisecond on LiC and on gpt-oss SWE-Together sessions and a median of 20 20 ms on the longer Qwen3-Coder SWE-Together sessions, well below the compression latency of every baseline. Almost all of this time extracts identifiers from the history text, so it grows linearly with history length; because blocks do not change once written, their identifier sets can be computed once and reused. Updating the graph from attention statistics, including the moving average, edge merging, and the supersession test, takes a median of 3.7 3.7 ms per turn with Qwen3-Coder and 0.35 0.35 ms with gpt-oss on SWE-Together.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个CPU核心(AMD EMYC 7453)来计算ReCAP的上下文选择,从块分割到打分、包装和依赖性扩展。 表4按要求报告了时间。 选择在LIC和gpt-oss SWE-Together session上需要1毫秒左右,在更长的Qune3-Coder SWE-Together session上需要20ms的中位数,远低于每个基线的压缩时空. 几乎所有的时间都从历史文本中提取标识符,因此它随着历史长度的线性增长;因为块一写就不会改变,所以它们的标识符集可以一次计算,再使用. 从注意力统计中更新图,包括移动平均值、边缘合并和超会话测试,在SWE-Together上,每转弯的中位数为3.7米/秒和0.35米/秒。

blocks.en: Attention interface. Native integration obtains sampled attention rows from retained query vectors, or their source hidden states, and resident keys. Importance extraction samples current-turn positions across a layer band; dependency extraction samples positions within each block at one selected layer. The sampled rows are reduced to block statistics at the turn boundary. Subsequent context selection reads these stored statistics and the graph’s adjacency information.

blocks.en: Request construction and context limits. The proxy rewrites the request’s message array with the selected blocks. When history is omitted, a system notice identifies the omission and states that the workspace remains available for retrieving further details. Selection uses the same history boundary, graph version, request, and random seed throughout a user turn. The engine enforces a 360k-character request cap by dropping the oldest selected blocks when the full request exceeds the limit. This guardrail takes precedence over protected-record retention and prefix stability.

Identifier extraction for Eq. 2 uses message content and matches code-like tokens of length ≥ 4 \geq 4 , including dotted file paths, under a short stop list; document frequencies are computed within the session.
